units.source_text: “老大爷，请多保重，天快变冷了。”

en.t: Old sir, please take good care of yourself; it will soon be getting cold.

units.source_text: 我由衷地说了一句，站了起来。

en.t: I said this from the heart, then stood up.

units.source_text: 老大爷呆滞无神地动了动枯黄的眼睛，微微点了点头。

en.t: The old man moved his dull, lifeless, yellowed eyes and gave a faint nod.
